name: Retro Web
thesis: A teal-wallpaper desktop strewn with beveled '98-era OS windows — hard outset/inset bevels, navy title bars, pixel/MS-Sans type, and knowingly-naff web-1.0 widgets (hit counter, marquee, guestbook, webring, 88x31 buttons) — proving Fancy primitives can wear desktop-OS chrome.

tokens.bg: teal desktop #2c7a7b → #1f5e5f radial, with a faint 45deg pinstripe; window chrome face #c7c3bb, document paper #fffef6
tokens.fg: #1a1a17 near-black ink; secondary #44423b; mono labels #6b685e; title-bar text #fff on navy
tokens.accent: #000080 navy (title bars / primary) + #aa00aa magenta (links/hover) + #008000 GO-green for affirmative actions; #e6a700 under-construction yellow
tokens.fontDisplay: Verdana / Geneva / Tahoma (bumpy 90s sans), 800 weight, magenta drop-shadow on the wordmark
tokens.fontMono: Lucida Console / Courier New for all labels, counters, timestamps, URLs
tokens.radius: 0 everywhere — square corners; only the folder tabs round their top 6px
tokens.border: 2px hard bevels: outset = light(top/left)+shadow(bottom/right), inset = the reverse; plus a 3px offset hard drop-shadow (no blur) on raised windows
tokens.motion: CSS-only gags: a 26s scrolling marquee, a 1s blinking cursor, a bobbing 🚧 sign, a pulsing online dot, an odometer hit counter; ALL disabled under prefers-reduced-motion

layout: A single centered ~1080px column floating on a tiled teal desktop, topped by a full-bleed scrolling marquee status strip. Every major section is its own draggable-looking OS window (FauxClient browser chrome: navy gradient title bar with a fake path/URL + traffic dots, inset white document body). The hero window splits 1.7fr/1fr into a wordmark + CTA column and a sidebar stacking a 'fieldwork.txt' property panel, an odometer hit counter, and a live clock. Work is a two-pane file explorer (file list + properties pane). About/team and contact/guestbook are paired two-up window rows. A lone rotated Post-it and a webmaster footer bar (88x31 badges + copyright + 'back to top') close it out.

sections.name: marquee
sections.what: Full-bleed black scrolling status ticker in phosphor green above everything — the OS notification bar.
sections.restyle: Hand-rolled CSS marquee (duplicated track + translateX keyframe) — there is no Fancy Marquee primitive.

sections.name: hero
sections.what: Main OS window: FIELD_WORK wordmark with a blinking cursor, tagline, two chrome buttons, an animated under-construction banner; sidebar with a property panel, hit counter, and clock.
sections.restyle: FauxClient becomes a literal 98 window via barClassName/bodyClassName overrides (navy gradient bar, inset paper body). Buttons become 3D outset chrome buttons that depress on :active.

sections.name: stats
sections.what: Four desktop-icon tiles — Founded / Projects / People online / Awards — each an emoji glyph over a Verdana number.
sections.restyle: Plain beveled tiles with hard drop-shadows; no Fancy primitive needed (they're static).

sections.name: selected-work
sections.what: 'My Projects' file-explorer window — a selectable file list on the left drives a Windows-style Properties pane on the right.
sections.restyle: Pillbox → inset beveled search field with square navy chips. The file list/properties pane are hand-built around controlled selection state; selected row paints navy like a highlighted OS file.

sections.name: capabilities
sections.what: Services / Process / F.A.Q. behind manila folder tabs.
sections.restyle: Tabs → raised manila folder tabs (rounded-top, active tab lifts and connects to the panel). Accordion → a collapsible 'My Documents' tree with 📁 rows, dotted child guides, and bevel headers.

sections.name: about-team
sections.what: Two-up: an 'About This Studio' window with a pull-quote + a design webring strip, beside a 'staff/' window listing the crew as online users.
sections.restyle: Avatar → square pixel portrait (border-radius 0, mono initials) inset in a beveled frame on a per-member color; each member row is a beveled 'user is online' list item with a glowing green dot.

sections.name: recognition-clients
sections.what: Awards spec-ledger table beside a wall of 88x31 client/web buttons, a press list, and a 'Valid HTML' badge.
sections.restyle: Table → beveled spec ledger (gray raised headers, zebra rows, mono year cells). Badge → the canonical 88x31 web button in rotating navy/magenta/teal/green, wrapped in a Tooltip styled as a yellow OS hint balloon.

sections.name: contact-guestbook
sections.what: Two-up: a 'New Message' brief box (Card/Composer/Progress) beside a working guestbook (read existing entries, sign with a handle, optimistic new entry).
sections.restyle: Card → beveled email window (navy caption bar + inset body + chrome footer). Composer → inset mono text area. Progress → segmented striped 98 loading bar. The guestbook + sign form are hand-built controlled state (new entry prepends as a highlighted Post-it-yellow row).

sections.name: ps-note
sections.what: A single rotated Post-it note signed by the founder.
sections.restyle: StickyNote restyled to a hard-edged Comic-Sans Post-it with a no-blur offset drop-shadow.

sections.name: footer
sections.what: Webmaster bar: a row of 88x31 vanity badges, copyright/style line, 'back to the gallery' link + 'back to top'.
sections.restyle: Badges reuse the 88x31 treatment; links are underlined blue web-1.0 anchors that turn magenta on hover.

palette.restyle: The backbone — every section is a FauxClient browser window. barClassName paints a navy→sky gradient title bar with white bold text + a fake DOS/URL path; bodyClassName makes the viewport an inset off-white document. The whole frame gets 2px outset bevels + a 3px hard offset shadow.

3D outset chrome button: gray face, light top/left + dark bottom/right bevel, inset highlight; flips to inset bevel + 1px nudge on :active; GO actions tint the label green; disabled goes embossed-gray, not faded.
Becomes the 88x31 'web button' — fixed ~88px min-width, mono caps, 1px black border with an inner white hairline, cycling navy/magenta/teal/green fills.
Manila folder tabs — rounded-top raised tabs sitting on a 2px rule; the active tab lifts, recolors navy, and merges into the panel below.
Beveled spec ledger — raised gray uppercase headers, hairline cell borders, zebra paper rows, mono year column, navy project column.
Collapsible 'My Documents' tree — 📁 bevel-header rows with dotted left guides on the expanded content.
Square pixel portrait — border-radius 0, mono initials, framed in a beveled inset square over a per-member solid color.
Segmented striped 98 loading bar inside an inset well — discrete navy ticks rather than a smooth fill.
Inset white mono text area (the message body of an email window).
Inset beveled search field with square navy chips and mono text.
Hard-edged Comic-Sans Post-it with a no-blur offset shadow, slightly rotated.
A 2px groove rule (1px dark over 1px light) — the engraved divider OS dialogs use.
Pale-yellow OS hint balloon with a 1px black border and a hard offset shadow.
Beveled email/message window — navy caption bar, inset paper body, gray chrome footer.
Headings render in bumpy 800-weight Verdana navy with a groove underline; body/labels drop to Lucida Console mono for the system-text feel.

contentArchetype: A fictional design/dev studio (FIELDWORK) homepage circa 1999 — wordmark + tagline, a file-explorer portfolio of named '.exe' projects, services/process/FAQ in folder tabs, an about pull-quote + webring, an awards ledger + 88x31 client buttons, a 'drop us a line' brief box, and a working guestbook. Garnished with the obligatory hit counter, marquee, under-construction banner, and 'Valid HTML 4.01' badge.
remix: Keep ONE structural rule — every region is an OS window (title bar + inset body) — and the rest follows: 2px hard bevels (light TL / dark BR), zero border-radius, mono+Verdana, navy/magenta/green on gray-and-paper. To make it less kitsch for a real product, drop the marquee/hit-counter/under-construction gags and keep just the window chrome + bevels for a tasteful 'OS app' shell; to go further into vaporwave, swap the teal wallpaper for a magenta→cyan gradient and add CRT scanlines. Blends naturally with a Terminal style (share the inset-well + mono treatment) or a Brutalist style (both lean on hard borders and zero radius).
